svg.text: Weld on: a 25 mm (1 in) socket in the left side, centred, for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: coil outlet; a 3/4 in socket on top 60 behind the centre for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: relief valve; a 1/4 in socket on top 70 in front for the gauge;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a DN32 branch out of the front cap to the seal pot;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 3/4 in nipple out of the back cap to the diverter.
